title: Basic Rumba TOP TEN STEPS & ROUTINE

extraction.teacher_style: The teachers provide clear, structured breakdowns with separate instruction for leaders and followers. They combine humor with detailed technical corrections.

lesson_structure.note: Introduction of Tytus and LiWen from Dance Insanity
Overview of what will be taught in the video
Explanation of learning in 3 levels: Patterns, Technique, Performance
Listing the top ten Rumba steps
Starting with footwork: leader left foot, follower right foot
Step 1: Basic step breakdown for partner, follower, and leader
Step 2: Cucaracha breakdown with partner, follower, and leader
Technical advice on closing feet correctly
Step 3: Side Step breakdown for partner, follower, and leader
Step 4: Under Arm Turn breakdown and tips
Leading mistakes to avoid during under arm turn
Step 5: New Yorker breakdown for partner, follower, and leader

common_mistakes: Too late with the under arm turn

steps_taught.name: Basic
steps_taught.description: Rock forward, replace, side, rock back, replace, side

steps_taught.name: Cucaracha
steps_taught.description: Side, replace, close side, replace, close

steps_taught.name: Side Step
steps_taught.description: Side, close, side, side, close, side

steps_taught.name: Under Arm Turn
steps_taught.description: Under arm turn using basic step footwork with arm circle over head

steps_taught.name: New Yorker
steps_taught.description: Quarter turn rock step, replace, side, quarter turn rock step, replace, side

what_works: Clear separation of leader and follower footwork
Step-by-step numbering and titles on screen
